items.reason: The PR changes reference selection to iterate every calendar reference (packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts:418–424), while the fallback sends each reference’s identifiers to every calendar credential without matching its provider or account (475–480). Wrong-account deletions can reject, as Office365 propagates deletion errors (packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:111–121); these rejections also skip cancellation emails (handleCancelBooking.ts:656–665).
